name: @bossnyumba/ussd-engine
description: Pure USSD menu-tree + session state machine. Feature-phone ingress for tenants (renters) and property owners on low-bandwidth networks (*123# -> menu -> action): check a lease, see rent due, submit a meter reading, check a maintenance request, browse vacant units. Bilingual en/sw, 182-char screen budget, 180s session TTL. Pure functions + injected ports (session store, identity resolver, data fetchers, clock) — no direct DB/SDK/env. Default-OFF feature flag with a single wireUssdEngine() composition export. Ported and fully re-skinned to the BossNyumba real-estate domain.
